comments: Em chord strums (0-0-0-2-2-0) with muted x columns; the up/down arrows between columns are strum-direction marks and were ignored. At the right end of string 1 the text runs out of dashes: '0 5 0 0 3' are spaced digits with no dashes between them (not touching). I read them as five separate notes because they complete the repeating riff 7-0-0-5-0-0-3(-0). The final 3 sits at the right edge but looks complete.
